parameters.root_recovery_change: replace known-hit-root scan with direct roots of x^2+b*x+c plus hit-root membership
selection_features: factor zero on selected leaf point
candidate ranks under deterministic public base orders

summary.interpretation: The selected factor order is public and pre-registered through the early-stop/rank-ensemble policies. Direct quadratic root recovery charges two candidate roots per selected zero leaf instead of a known-hit-root scan. This strengthens the current FFE quotient lead only over the existing surface bank; fresh-row validation is still required before claiming a general ECDLP speedup.
